messages:
Ava (People Ops): Hey team — heads up that our annual attestations + privacy refresher window opens Monday 04/20. This year were combining three asks into a short 10-day sprint to make it less disruptive. Please skim below and action by 04/29 EOD.

Ava (People Ops): What we need from you: 1) Complete the 12-minute privacy microtraining (link). 2) Fill the attestation form (link) confirming youve followed data handling policies. 3) Upload any updated control evidence to the Evidence Drive if you own controls.

Ava (People Ops): Naming rules for uploads: team_controlID_description_YYYYMMDD.pdf (example: product_AC-6_privacy-policy_20240421.pdf). Put files in /Evidence/Annual-Attestation/ then update the attestation tracker spreadsheet.

Kai (Legal): Quick note on training: if your work touches customer PII, please complete the optional redaction checklist after the microtraining. Well need a signed confirmation in the Evidence Drive for any redacted items.

Jordan (Security): For folks with alerting or incident artifacts, include one pager that explains scope, detection method, and retention period. If youre linking to dashboards, include a link and one-line access instructions.

Maya (Product): Can someone flag the controls my team owns? Im doing a sweep to see what needs updates.

Ava (People Ops): Maya — Product owns AC-2, AC-6, and SI-4 this cycle. Ill add you to the tracker as the default owner; update if someone else should own.

Maya (Product): Thanks — will triage with the team.

DevOnCallBot: Reminder: 2 artifacts missing from infra for SI-4. Please upload by 04/25 or open an exception ticket.

Jordan (Security): If you need a brief extension for legal review, open an "attestation-exception" ticket and tag @Kai. Well review within 48h.

Ava (People Ops): Were running two virtual office hours for uploads and attestation Q&A: Tue 09:30-10:30 and Fri 16:00-17:00 in #help. Drop in with filenames and Ill verify.

Maya (Product): Office hours work great. One question: are older SOPs still valid or do we need a fresh SOP snapshot?

Kai (Legal): If the SOP was updated in the last 12 months, upload the latest. If older, include a short note about why its still accurate or mark for review.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: complete microtraining, submit attestation, upload evidence, or open an exception. Deadline 04/29 EOD. Ping me with questions. :sparkles:
